confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three web searches of 2026 travel-guide and price-aggregator pages, which are crowd-sourced or estimated, so they are approximate. Beer and cocktail anchors are the better-supported drink figures; the wine glass anchor has no direct Seattle source and is inferred from the beer and cocktail anchors. Meal and cocktail figures are pre-tax and pre-tip, and the mid-range meal figure may include tax and fees per its source. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Seattle context; no accommodation prices were searched or inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are based on Seattle-specific price sources for food and drink, with the wine glass inferred from local beer and cocktail relationships. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a large US West Coast city with high hotel demand.
